hooks.command: stage=$(jq -r '.env.FACTORY_STAGE // empty' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$stage" ] && echo "⚠️  FACTORY_STAGE is unset — set it in .claude/settings.json before running pipeline commands" || echo "📍 Factory stage: $stage"

f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.json) prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "✓ Formatted: $(basename $f)";; *.py) black "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "✓ Formatted: $(basename $f)";; *.ts|*.tsx) prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "✓ Formatted: $(basename $f)";; esac || true
